newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Norma sees '97 profit at 50.2 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Norma sees '97 profit at 50.2 mln kroons.

text.p: Estonian plastic maker Norma said on Friday it expects next year's profit to be 50.2 million kroons and to have sales of 400 million kroons.

The company is one of the leading suppliers of seat belt attachments in eastern Europe but it said in a statement that the forecast for next year was not based on expectations of favourable growth in the eastern market.

Norma, quoted on the over-the-counter market of the Tallinn stock exchange, also said it expected to invest some 49.2 million kroons next year. The company has previously said it expects to make 62 million kroons in 1996.
